name: Single-leg balance
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished exercise cover matching the supplied reference model exactly: same tall slender adult male, modest muscle definition, tan skin, short dark wavy hair, smooth completely faceless head, charcoal tank top, teal shorts, barefoot. Clean softly shaded illustration on a flat opaque warm off-white background with subtle grounding shadow, no transparency, no text or labels. Landscape 3:2, intended 1200x800. Keep entire figure and exercise equipment visible with margins. Reference image defines identity, clothing and illustration style; do not copy the reference sheet layout. Exercise: Single-leg balance. Standing upright on ONE flat bare foot, supporting heel grounded, other knee slightly bent and foot suspended off floor, arms relaxed beside body. Calm forward head orientation, eyes-open intent but keep face completely featureless. Front three-quarter view.
